review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. California Sea Grant and Florida Museum sources support shallow benthic bay habitat and behavioral thermal movement, but not a numeric preferred SST band.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for bat ray.
factors.value_notes: California Sea Grant and Florida Museum describe bat rays moving toward warmer inshore water during cooler periods and into cooler/deeper water during warmer periods, but neither establishes a numeric preferred SST range or catch-response curve. The configured 13-22 °C range and 15-20 °C ideal remain unsupported by species-specific numeric temperature evidence; keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for bat ray.
factors.value_notes: California Sea Grant reports intertidal-to-180 m occurrence and shallow bay/slough nurseries; Florida Museum reports common shallow muddy/sandy bays and kelp habitat from 1-46 m. This supports the configured 1-30 m shallow-bay screen but does not validate the 3-25 m ideal or capture the full depth envelope.
